_comment: Tier-2: DEM is always 3D internally — the MDPA must reference SphericParticle3D even for a problem posed in a 2D plane, and there is NO SphericParticle2D. Pitfall (kratos._auxiliary_overview #4). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). CreateNewElement('SphericParticle2D', ...) raises RuntimeError 'The Element "SphericParticle2D" is not registered!'; SphericParticle3D constructs. This is the auxiliary-overview copy of the claim; the dem-section copy (dem #3) has its own fixture, dem_spheric_particle_2d_rejected. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
